t: Grid Trade Master Agreement - Wikipedia
s: March 9, 2023 - The Grid Trade Master Agreement (GTMA) is an agreement for trading electricity within the United Kingdom. It is normally used either when a power station has excess electricity, which it wishes to "sell back" to the power grid, or when the electricity company wishes to buy surplus power to meet a surge in demand, or reduction in supply.
